text: Caption 'Now card 81. Its number can be changed...' sits over the board's verdict line for card 47 ('Still searching, and it always will be: 2+2=5 is false...'), hiding part of it while looking at the board from the desk (pitch -25).

Verdict table (12 proves it/yes, 47 searches forever/no, 81 searches forever/YES) + 'To the Prover, cards 47 and 81 look the same. Only from outside can you see that 81 is true.' is clearly readable when standing at the desk facing the board (4 m).
